# Dendrogram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasDendrogram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasDendrogram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasDendrogram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasDendrogram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A tree: clustering / phylogenetic, or a Gource-style radial filesystem

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasDendrogramExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDendrogramExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasMindMapProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasMindMapProposal.md)
- [UltraCanvasGitGraphProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasGitGraphProposal.md)

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasDendrogram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onLeafClicked` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onLeafClicked` | _Leaf clicked_ |
| `onInternalNodeClicked` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onInternalNodeClicked` | @param nodeId — clicked leaf node |
| `onNodeHovered` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeHovered` | @param nodeId — clicked internal (merge) node |
| `onGroupClicked` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onGroupClicked` | @param nodeId — hovered node (any type), empty string = no hover |
| `onGroupHighlighted` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, bool)> onGroupHighlighted` | @param groupId — user clicked a group region or label |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>&)> onSelectionChanged` | @param groupId, isEntering — hover enter/leave on group |
| `onNodeCollapsed` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, bool)> onNodeCollapsed` | @param selectedLeafIds — set changed after click with shift/ctrl |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
